HighScore.title: HighScore
HighScore.description: Represents a user's high score and completion stats for a specific puzzle board.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated player who achieved the score.

displayName.description: Display name or handle of the player (non-PII).

puzzleId.description: Unique identifier of the puzzle (e.g., daily-4x4-2026-11-09).

score.description: Highest score achieved by the player on this puzzle.

totalWords.description: Total number of required words in the puzzle.

bonusWordsCount.description: Number of bonus dictionary words uncovered.

foundFeatured.description: Whether the player uncovered the featured Missing Piece word.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score record was last updated.

/highscores/{scoreId}.description: Stores verified player high scores per puzzle board.
